evals.prompt: Use the modules skill. Create a module 'Billing v2' in project TaskFlow, led by Alice, targeting June 30 2026. Say how you find the tools and resolve the ids, show the create call, and say what you offer next. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Resolves project and lead UUIDs, calls module(action=create) with status='planned'.
expectations: The answer resolves the project with project(action=list)
The answer finds Alice's user id with member(action=list_project, project_id=<id>)
The answer creates the module with module(action=create, project_id, name="Billing v2", ...)
The answer sets lead=<Alice's user uuid> and target_date=2026-06-30 in the create call
The answer sets status="planned" in the create call
The answer offers module(action=manage_workitems, module_id, add_ids=[...]) as the next step
